note: Sites are wooden platforms, reinforced with concrete and steel, built into the wooded slopes above Center Hill Lake; the park asks anyone bringing a trailer to read each site's description before booking. The reservation site lists most pads at 28 ft and only a few longer. Three bathhouses; the camp store opens from Memorial Day to Labor Day. Nine walk-in primitive sites sit on a bluff near the campground. --Claude
summary: State park campground re-read: 60 platform sites (water + 20/30/50-amp, no sewer), $32-63 by tier and holiday (stored high 50 -> 63), max 40 ft but most 28 ft, about 22 sites bookable in winter. Lakeview re-checked hard and kept: pads sit 6-15 m above summer pool on wooded slopes 35-80 m from the shore; official campsite photo shows the lake through trees. Phone 931-858-2446 appears on no park page.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakeview kept after a hard check. The campground covers the wooded point at ~36.0814,-85.8324; on Esri imagery and 3DEP the outer loop road runs at 203-213 m, 35-80 m from the shoreline at 193-197 m (Center Hill summer pool 648 ft = 197.5 m), so the platforms sit 6-15 m above the water on steep wooded slopes - fails the kayak test, no lakefront candidate. Views are filtered: the park's camping hero photo, taken from a campsite, shows the lake through trees, and the page says the sites are 'built around the slopes of Center Hill Lake'. Closest to the water are the east-side loop sites (outer road ~36.08140,-85.83057, ~37 m from the shore at 36.08126,-85.83018, ~8 m above it). The catalog gives no per-site water tags.

PHONE 931-858-2446 -> 931-646-3080 (the park's contact number and 'Campground Info November through February'; the camping page also gives 'Campground Info March through October 1-931-858-2618', the camp store's number). The stored 858-2446 appears on neither page.
FEES high 50 -> 63 (holiday weekends on sites 37-44/47-60); low 32 unchanged. reservation_fee set null (policy row holds the $5).

SITES: max_rig_ft 40 kept, but only sites 39, 47, 50 and 53 are 40 ft; most are 28 ft and 26, 34, 41 are 30-31 ft. The park page's 'up to 33 feet' is above what the reservation site lists for most pads. A 23-ft rig fits every RV site. Sites 31 and 32 were never bookable across eight two-week windows (likely host/staff sites).

SEASON (manual, unchanged): consistent with the calendar - in January and February only sites 30 and 33-54 are bookable (about 22, matching 'Approximately 20 sites'); sites 1-29 and 55-60 reopen in spring. Stored year_round true and its note stand.
PIN 36.08140,-85.83240 sits inside the loops on the point; fine.
Note cleaned: dropped amperage, hookups, max length, the reservation fee, 'State-operated' and the year-round count (all shown by fields, the season note or the policy row). No --AWH text.
Park alert 2026-11-24: Merritt Ridge Trail temporarily closed for storm damage (trail only; campground unaffected).
